title: Lamb Tagine with Middle Eastern Flavors
description: A hearty and flavorful Moroccan lamb stew made with tender lamb, aromatic spices, and sweet dried fruits. This rich and comforting dish is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and turmeric. Cook for 1 minute.
Add apricots and 2 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 hours, or until lamb is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley.
